lines.en: label kirinspring3:
Time: 4:43 AM\nLocation: Kumon-mi High\nMood: Bad
lines.zh: 时间：凌晨 4:43\n地点：Kumon-mi 高中\n心情：糟糕

lines.en: scene kirinfield1
There isn’t much I remember from my youth.
lines.zh: 我对年少时记得的事不多。

lines.en: Too much time has passed now.
lines.zh: 毕竟已经过去太久了。

lines.en: But among the things I {i}do{/i} remember, there’s one very specific sensation that gives me goosebumps to this day whenever I’m feeling despondent enough to recall it.
lines.zh: 但在我{i}还{/i}记得的那些事里，有一种非常特别的感受，直到今天，每当我消沉到足以回想起来时，都会让我起鸡皮疙瘩。

lines.en: It’s spring. And starting next week, we won’t need to come to school for a while.
lines.zh: 那是春天。从下周开始，我们就有一阵子不用去学校了。

lines.en: Today, we do, though.
lines.zh: 不过今天还得去。

lines.en: The air is crisp. It’s cold, but I can handle it without a jacket. My hair is wet from the shower.
lines.zh: 空气清冽。很冷，但不穿外套我也扛得住。我的头发刚洗完澡还是湿的。

lines.en: There’s a slight soreness on my right shoulder from where my backpack rests, tugging at the skin and forcing me to adjust it every thirty seconds or so.
lines.zh: 右肩因为背着书包有点酸痛，勒着皮肤，逼得我大约每三十秒就得调整一次。

lines.en: I see someone. I recognize her.
lines.zh: 我看见一个人。我认得她。

lines.en: We don’t speak, but we’ll make eye contact every once in a while, silently acknowledging each other’s existence as we stare up at a dull blue sky, reveling in the quiet, contemplative peace we can only experience now.
lines.zh: 我们不说话，但偶尔会目光相接，在抬头望着那片暗淡蓝天的同时，无声地承认彼此的存在，沉浸在这份只有此刻才能体会的、安静而沉思的平和里。

lines.en: When college starts, we won’t need to wake up this early anymore. We can make our schedules as we see fit. And abandon these moments that, presently, we don’t yet realize we love.
lines.zh: 等上了大学，我们就不用再起这么早了。我们可以随心所欲地安排时间。然后抛下这些此刻我们还不知道自己热爱的瞬间。

lines.en: One day, though, we’ll look back on those mornings before school. The crackle of fallen branches beneath our feet as the low roar of the bus finally comes within earshot.
lines.zh: 不过总有一天，我们会回想起那些上学前的清晨。想起脚下枯枝的碎裂声，想起巴士低沉的轰鸣终于传入耳中。

lines.en: We will long for the warmth. The fading of goosebumps as we step inside and find our seat not quite in the back, yet not quite in the front either.
lines.zh: 我们会怀念那份温暖。怀念走进车厢、找到那个既不靠后也不靠前的座位时，鸡皮疙瘩渐渐消退的感觉。

lines.en: It’s like things get brighter each block we travel. The sun is waking up again. My hair is still drying.
lines.zh: 仿佛每走过一个街区，一切就更亮一点。太阳又醒了。我的头发还没干。

lines.en: And in ten minutes, I’ll be right behind that girl I pretend to never think about, thinking about how I always wind up thinking about her.
lines.zh: 而十分钟后，我就会站在那个我假装从不去想的女孩身后，想着我怎么总是又会想起她。

lines.en: It’s suddenly cold again. I’m outside. The moon is vanishing. My shoulder hurts once more.
lines.zh: 突然又冷了起来。我在室外。月亮正在消失。我的肩膀又开始疼。

lines.en: And I don’t realize this is what happiness is.
lines.zh: 而我没有意识到，这就是幸福。

lines.en: Kirin Kanda didn’t normally wake up this early. And, on a technical level, that was true again today for she hadn’t woken up at all.
lines.zh: Kirin Kanda 平时不会起这么早。而从技术层面说，今天也一样——因为她根本没睡。

lines.en: She was here because she {i}couldn’t{/i} sleep. Because she’d gotten into a fight with her parents and spent the night waiting for an apology that never came and never {i}would{/i} come.
lines.zh: 她在这儿是因为{i}睡不着{/i}。因为她和父母吵了一架，整晚都在等一个永远{i}不会{/i}来的道歉。

lines.en: She was cold, but she could handle it without a jacket.
lines.zh: 她很冷，但不穿外套也扛得住。

lines.en: And it wouldn’t be long now until the doors of the school would open and she could wait out the rest of the morning in the cafeteria, separating herself from the silence because the silence made her think.
lines.zh: 而不出多久，学校的门就会打开，她可以在食堂里熬过剩下的早晨，把自己从寂静中隔开，因为寂静会让她思考。

lines.en: If she dissolved into nothing right now, no one would notice at first. No one would question it.
lines.zh: 如果她此刻就这样消融成虚无，起初没人会注意到。没人会起疑。

lines.en: Her parents, her friends, and her sister would all assume rebellion. And it wouldn’t be until her remains began to drift across the sea that anyone would realize something was wrong.
lines.zh: 她的父母、她的朋友、她的姐姐，全都会把这当成叛逆。而直到她的残骸漂洋过海，才会有人意识到出了事。

lines.en: That’s how it always is.
lines.zh: 事情一向如此。

lines.en: But in the morning, in the cold, the world finally feels like it wants us.
lines.zh: 但在清晨，在寒冷里，这个世界终于像是需要我们了。

lines.en: {size=-2}Like the moon is gazing down, greeting us with the “good morning” we never get from the girl at the bus stop before following us to school. Never losing its place in the sky until we’re finally where we’re meant to be.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}像是月亮正低头注视，用那句我们从不会从车站的女孩那里得到的“早上好”跟我们打招呼，然后一路跟着我们去学校。在我们终于到达该去的地方之前，它在天上的位置从不偏移。{/size}

lines.en: Even when we {i}are,{/i} though...
lines.zh: 可即便我们{i}到了{/i}……

lines.en: Even when {i}she{/i} is...
lines.zh: 即便{i}她{/i}到了……

lines.en: It all feels incorrect.
lines.zh: 一切都感觉不对劲。

lines.en: Perhaps it was all just too good to be true.
lines.zh: 也许这一切都美好得不真实。

lines.en: scene black
scene kirinfield2
: You look larger than normal today, Mr. Moon. I take it you’ve been working out?
lines.zh: : 你今天看起来比平时更大，月亮先生。我猜你一直在锻炼？

lines.en: : Why yes, Kirin! Thank you very much for noticing!
lines.zh: : 为什么是的，Kirin！非常感谢你的关注！

lines.en: : You don’t seem all that happy yourself, though. Are you feeling unloved again?
lines.zh: : 不过你自己看起来也不太开心。又觉得没人爱你了？

lines.en: : A little. Do you think that’s childish of me, Mr. Moon?
lines.zh: : 有一点。你觉得这很幼稚吗，月亮先生？

lines.en: : We all feel that way sometimes, Kirin. It’s not something that can be helped.
lines.zh: : 我们有时都会有这种感觉，Kirin。这是没办法的事。

lines.en: : Ever?
lines.zh: : 永远都没办法？

lines.en: : That’s right! You’re destined to periodically feel this way from the moment you gain consciousness up until the moment you die! So it’s best to just learn how to deal with it now before it’s too late!
lines.zh: : 没错！从你获得意识的那一刻起，到你死去的那一刻为止，你注定会周期性地有这种感觉！所以最好现在就学会怎么应付，免得为时已晚！

lines.en: : What happens when it’s too late?
lines.zh: : 为时已晚会怎么样？

lines.en: : When it’s too late, you won’t even {i}want{/i} to get out of bed anymore! But the fact that you were able to today is proof that you have it in you to move forward!
lines.zh: : 为时已晚的时候，你会连床都{i}不想起{/i}！可你今天能起得来，这本身就证明你有继续往前走的本事！

lines.en: : Keep pushing, Kirin! Find a purpose! For one day, you’ll know that all of this anguish was worth it! And that you’re just as special, if not {i}more,{/i} than everybody else!
lines.zh: : 继续加油，Kirin！找到一个目标！因为总有一天，你会知道这一切的痛苦都是值得的！也会知道你和大家一样特别，甚至{i}比他们更{/i}特别！

lines.en: : You’re starting to sound like those self-help podcasts I listen to.
lines.zh: : 你说话开始像我听的那些自助播客了。

lines.en: : Well, that’s probably because I’m the manifestation of your innermost thoughts and not actually a talking moon!
lines.zh: : 嗯，那大概是因为我是你内心想法的化身，而不是什么会说话的月亮！

lines.en: : I’m only saying these things because they’re exactly what you want to hear despite lacking the resolve to actually reach out and ask for help from a real person!
lines.zh: : 我说这些，只是因为它们恰恰就是你想听的话——尽管你没有真的鼓起勇气去向一个真人求助！

lines.en: : Well, damn, Mr. Moon. Couldn’t you at least wait until it’s a little brighter outside to rain all over my parade?
lines.zh: : 好吧，该死，月亮先生。你就不能至少等到外面亮一点再给我泼冷水吗？

lines.en: : It’s the clouds who are responsible for rain, Kirin! I’m just a big, stupid space rock who follows you to school every day!
lines.zh: : 下雨是云的活儿，Kirin！我只是块又大又蠢的太空石头，每天跟着你去学校而已！

lines.en: : Kirin?
lines.zh: : Kirin？

lines.en: scene kirinfield3
: Oh. Miku. Hey.
lines.zh: : 哦。Miku。嗨。

lines.en: : I wasn’t talking to the moon or anything if that’s what it looked like.
lines.zh: : 我可不是在跟月亮说话什么的，如果你看着像的话。

lines.en: : Weird, cause that’s exactly what it looked like. The heck you doin’ here so early?
lines.zh: : 奇怪，因为看着就是那么回事。你这么早在这儿干嘛呢？

lines.en: : What are {i}you{/i} doing here so early? And in your...soccer uniform no less? The soccer club’s been disbanded for years.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}这么早在这儿干嘛？还穿着……足球队服？足球俱乐部都解散好几年了。

lines.en: scene kirinfield4
: Ah...yeah. Yeah, I...know that.
lines.zh: : 啊……对。对，我……知道。

lines.en: : I still kind of...come here before school all the time, though. I...guess I just miss it and...stuff.
lines.zh: : 不过我还是经常……在上学前跑来这儿。我……大概只是想念它，还有……什么的。

lines.en: : Really? Why don’t you ever invite me? I’d come play with you.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那你怎么从不叫我？我会来陪你踢的。

lines.en: : You ain’t ever really been a morning person, though. And I-
lines.zh: : 可你从来不是个早起的人啊。而且我——

lines.en: scene kirinfield5
: Wait, yeah! You never answered my question! The heck are {i}you{/i} doin’ here so early? Cause you ain’t in uniform, so I’m sure it ain’t about soccer.
lines.zh: : 等等，对了！你还没回答我的问题！{i}你{/i}这么早在这儿干嘛？你又没穿队服，所以肯定不是为了足球。

lines.en: : Oh, just...you know. {i}Hanging out.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，就是……你知道的。{i}待着{/i}。

lines.en: scene kirinfield6
: Why didn’t you ask {i}me{/i} then? This one of them “alone time” things I’m interruptin’ right now?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不叫{i}我{/i}？这是那种我正打扰到的“独处时间”吗？

lines.en: : Miku, it’s not even 5:00 AM yet. Why would I invite you anywhere?
lines.zh: : Miku，现在还不到早上五点。我为什么要约你去哪儿？

lines.en: : Idunno. But I don’t know why you think I should invite {i}you{/i} to play soccer at 5:00 AM either if you ain’t gonna invite {i}me{/i} to sit around and look sad.
lines.zh: : 不知道。可我也不明白，如果你不会叫我大清早五点起来陪你坐着发呆，你凭什么觉得{i}我{/i}该叫{i}你{/i}去踢球。

lines.en: : Well, we can...hang out now, I guess? I can’t really play soccer in a skirt, though.
lines.zh: : 那我们……现在可以一起待着吧？不过我穿着裙子可没法踢球。

lines.en: scene black
: Not with that attitude, ya can’t.
lines.zh: : 就你这态度，当然不行。

lines.en: scene kirinfield7
: You doin’ okay? Cause I’m here to talk if ya need somebody, you know.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？你要是想找人聊聊，我在这儿，你知道的。

lines.en: : I know you are. I’m just being stupid and immature.
lines.zh: : 我知道你在。我只是又蠢又幼稚。

lines.en: : Think it’s a little more than bein’ stupid and immature if you’re out here talkin’ to the friggin’ moon.
lines.zh: : 如果你都在跟那该死的月亮说话了，那可不止是蠢和幼稚吧。

lines.en: scene kirinfield8
: {i}Okay.{/i} Then, I’m being {i}very{/i} stupid and immature. So stupid and immature that I couldn’t sleep {i}at all{/i} over an argument I can barely even {i}remember.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好吧{/i}。那我是{i}非常{/i}蠢、非常幼稚。蠢到幼稚到，为了一场我几乎都{i}记不清{/i}的争吵，{i}整晚{/i}睡不着。

lines.en: : {size=-8}Which just makes me {i}angry{/i} too so it’s a like a whole flood of shitty emotions that I can’t do anything about because they all happened in the middle of the night and nobody was awake and nobody would {i}care{/i} anyway and it’s like a million things are happening at once and I’m just overwhelmed and I would like you to interrupt me now because I’m running out of breath!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-8}这让我想起来也{i}生气{/i}，所以就像一整股烂情绪的洪水，我拿它们一点办法都没有，因为它们全发生在半夜，没人醒着，而且也没人会{i}在乎{/i}——就像有一百万件事同时发生，我只是被压垮了，我希望你现在打断我，因为我快喘不上气了！{/size}

lines.en: scene kirinfield9
: {i}Hah! Hah...hah...{/i}
: Feel better?
lines.zh: : 好点了吗？

lines.en: scene kirinfield10
: No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Maybe ya will later then. That’s how it worked for me.
lines.zh: : 那也许晚点会好起来。我就是这么过来的。

lines.en: scene kirinfield11
: Took a {i}bunch{/i} of sessions with my therapist for me to start feelin’ any better from talkin’ about stuff.
lines.zh: : 我看了{i}好多次{/i}心理医生，才开始因为 talk 出来而感觉好一点。

lines.en: : Probably gonna have to start that whole process over now, though, since Maki’s makin’ me get a new one.
lines.zh: : 不过现在大概得把整个过程重来一遍了，因为 Maki 要我换个新的。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: scene kirinfield12
: Somethin’ with Makoto preachin’ about the end of days or whatever.
lines.zh: : 好像是 Makoto 在宣扬什么末日之类的。

lines.en: : I don’t really get it. But we use the same person and if things ain’t workin’ for her, I’ve gotta man up and find somebody else too to show my support.
lines.zh: : 我其实不太懂。不过我们看的是同一个人，如果她那边不合适，我也得拿出点担当，另找一个，以示支持。

lines.en: : I always forget Makoto has depression. She seems so normal most of the time.
lines.zh: : 我总是忘了 Makoto 有抑郁症。她大多数时候看起来都很正常。

lines.en: scene kirinfield13
: She’s good at hidin’ stuff. Way better than you, at least. Ain’t ever found {i}her{/i} talkin’ to the moon. She’s normally sleepin’ like a baby when I head out in the morning too.
lines.zh: : 她很会藏。至少比你强多了。我从没发现过{i}她{/i}跟月亮说话。我早上出门的时候，她通常还睡得像个婴儿。

lines.en: : It’s not like this is normal for me. Things have just been...not that great lately.
lines.zh: : 这对我来说也不是常态。只是最近……不太顺。

lines.en: : I feel that, for sure. Pretty sure Maki’s startin’ to catch onto how Makoto and me have become semen demons. She don’t even want us talkin’ to Sensei anymore.
lines.zh: : 我懂，真的懂。而且我敢肯定 Maki 已经开始察觉，Makoto 和我变成了精液恶魔。她甚至都不想让我们再跟老师说话了。

lines.en: scene kirinfield14
: Heh...Meanwhile, {i}I{/i} keep feeling tempted to confess {i}everything{/i} to my parents just to see how they’d react. Or if they’d even react at all when, honestly, I doubt it.
lines.zh: : 呵……而{i}我呢{/i}，一直有种冲动想把{i}所有事{/i}都跟父母坦白，就为了看他们会怎么反应。或者说，他们到底会不会有反应——老实说，我怀疑不会。

lines.en: : They’ve never loved me, Miku. And I know you don’t like this subject, but I just...
lines.zh: : 他们从来没有爱过我，Miku。我知道你不喜欢这个话题，可我只是……

lines.en: : I just want to be noticed, you know? I want to be {i}seen.{/i} And, more often than not, it feels like my entire existence does nothing but make everyone’s life worse.
lines.zh: : 我只是想被注意到，你知道吗？我想{i}被看见{/i}。而大多数时候，我感觉自己的存在除了让每个人的生活更糟之外，什么用也没有。

lines.en: : Guess that whole archery thing ain’t workin’ out for ya then, huh?
lines.zh: : 这么说，那整个射箭的事对你也不太管用咯？

lines.en: scene kirinfield15
: Huh? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么意思？

lines.en: : Well, wasn’t the whole reason you didn’t follow me and Karin to the swim team so that you could “carve out your own path” or whatever?
lines.zh: : 嗯，你当初不跟我和 Karin 去游泳队，不就是为了“开辟自己的道路”什么的吗？

lines.en: : If you’re off doin’ your own thing and everything still feels wrong, can you really say it’s working? Are you really {i}happy{/i} tryin’ to be different when you know you’d feel more comfortable with us?
lines.zh: : 如果你在做自己的事，一切却还是感觉不对，那你真能说它奏效了吗？明明知道跟我们在一起会更自在，你还要硬去尝试与众不同，你真的{i}开心{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene kirinfield16
: It beats living in your shadows at least. That was the other part of why I didn’t follow you. I could never actually compete with you or Karin.
lines.zh: : 至少比活在你们的影子里强。这是我不跟你们去的另一个原因。我永远也比不过你或 Karin。

lines.en: : You think you’ll be able to compete with Uta and Touka then? Cause I heard Uta’s some kinda super archer and you just know Touka’s got her own kyudojo at home.
lines.zh: : 那你觉得你能比过 Uta 和 Touka 吗？我听说 Uta 是什么超厉害的弓手，而 Touka 家里肯定有一间自己的弓道场。

lines.en: scene kirinfield17
: Kirin...Don’t tell anybody else who was ever on the team I said this, but it’s okay to quit sometimes. Cause if you ain’t havin’ fun, what’s even the point?
lines.zh: : Kirin……别跟队里其他人说这话是我说的，不过有时候放弃也没关系。因为如果你连乐趣都没有，那到底图什么？

lines.en: : I just...want to be the best at something. {i}Anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我只是……想在某件事上做到最好。{i}什么都行{/i}。

lines.en: : The way I am now, I...feel {i}disposable.{/i} Like, what makes {i}me{/i} special?
lines.zh: : 我现在这个样子，感觉自己是{i}可以被随意丢弃的{/i}。比如，{i}我{/i}到底哪里特别？

lines.en: : Who says ya gotta be special at all?
lines.zh: : 谁说你非得特别了？

lines.en: scene kirinfield18
: Me! My parents! And probably a million other people too!
lines.zh: : 我！我爸妈！大概还有一百万个别的人！

lines.en: : Not Karin. Not Noriko. Not me. We all fell in love with you without you needin’ to do {i}anything{/i} special.
lines.zh: : Karin 没说过。Noriko 没说过。我也没说过。我们爱上你，从来不需要你做{i}什么{/i}特别的事。

lines.en: : Well, you’re all dumb! And that still doesn’t change the fact that I can’t figure out how to be happy with myself! Not when there’s a better version of me everywhere I look!
lines.zh: : 那你们全都是傻子！而且这还是改变不了我没办法跟自己和解的事实！一想到放眼望去处处都是比我更好的版本，我就做不到！

lines.en: : My parents know it! I know it! You know it! And the only person who {i}doesn’t{/i} know it is fucking Karin because that’s just how perfect and amazing and beautiful she is!
lines.zh: : 我爸妈知道！我知道！你也知道！而唯一{i}不知道{/i}的人就是他妈的 Karin，因为她就是那么完美、那么了不起、那么美！

lines.en: : I want to impress her too, Miku! I don’t want to feel like a leech anymore! Because all of the love I {i}do{/i} get just feels like pity to me! And I can’t escape that feeling no matter how hard I try!
lines.zh: : 我也想让她对我刮目相看，Miku！我不想再觉得自己像个寄生虫！因为我{i}得到{/i}的所有爱，在我看来都只是怜悯！而不管我怎么努力，我都逃不出这种感觉！

lines.en: scene kirinfield19
: And I’m...sorry for yelling. It just feels like no one ever understands even when I explain myself the best I can.
lines.zh: : 还有，我……为吼你道歉。只是感觉不管我怎么尽力解释，都没有人真的理解。

lines.en: : I’m tryin’...Think it’s hard to ever get how {i}anybody’s{/i} really feeling if you ain’t feelin’ it yourself, though.
lines.zh: : 我在努力……不过我想，如果你自己没有那种感受，就很难真的理解{i}别人{/i}到底在感受什么。

lines.en: scene kirinfield20
: I really {i}do{/i} think the answer is just...running away sometimes. But where would I even go?...
lines.zh: : 我{i}真的{/i}觉得答案有时候就是……逃跑。可我又能去哪儿呢？……

lines.en: : We’re trapped in here...We’re trapped in here and there’s no place for me, so why bother looking for one? Why try to be good at all? Why did I think I could do this?
lines.zh: : 我们被困在这里……我们被困在这里，而没有我的位置，那何必去找一个？何必去尝试变好？我当初凭什么觉得自己能做到？

lines.en: : I wish I knew what to say that would help, Kirin. But all I’ve really got is that I love you.
lines.zh: : 我真希望自己知道说什么能帮到你，Kirin。可我真正能给的，只有我爱你。

lines.en: : I love you too, Miku...
lines.zh: : 我也爱你，Miku……

lines.en: : It’d be really nice if that was enough.
lines.zh: : 要是那足够了，该多好。

lines.en: : Morning, Miku! Here early again I- wait, Kirin?
lines.zh: : 早上好，Miku！又来这么早——等等，Kirin？

lines.en: scene black
scene kirinfield21
: What are {i}you{/i} doing here? You don’t wake up early.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}在这儿干什么？你不早起的。

lines.en: : Morning...I-
: Kirin was talking to the moon.
lines.zh: : Kirin 在跟月亮说话。

lines.en: scene kirinfield22
: {i}Hah.{/i} Thanks, Miku. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}。谢了，Miku。我真是感激不尽。

lines.en: : Aww, was she?! She used to do that when she was little!
lines.zh: : 啊哇，是吗？！她小时候就老这么干！

lines.en: : Every night before bed, she’d open the window and say goodnight to the rabbit on the moon because she was afraid it was lonely.
lines.zh: : 每天晚上睡觉前，她都会打开窗户，跟月亮上的兔子说晚安，因为她怕它孤单。

lines.en: scene kirinfield23
: It wasn’t really until we got Pancake that she stopped doing it or- at least I {i}thought{/i} she stopped doing it, but apparently still {i}does{/i} because she’s just so cute and-
lines.zh: : 一直到我们养了 Pancake 她才不这么做了，或者——至少我{i}以为{/i}她不做了，但显然还{i}在做{/i}，因为她就是这么可爱，而且——

lines.en: : AAAAHHHH OKAY, OKAY, OKAY! NO MORE! I SUBMIT! DON’T EMBARRASS ME IN FRONT OF MIKU!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊好啦，好啦，好啦！我认输！别在 Miku 面前让我丢人！

lines.en: scene black
: Hey, there ain’t no need to be embarrassed! We all believe in the moon-rabbit when we’re kids. It’s that whole parold-dolia thing or whatever.
lines.zh: : 嘿，这有什么好害臊的！我们小时候都信月亮上的兔子。就是那个什么 parold-dolia 之类的。

lines.en: : Pareidolia.
lines.zh: : Pareidolia。

lines.en: : Yeah, that.
lines.zh: : 对，就那个。

lines.en: : Of course {i}you’d{/i} know the word. Show-off.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}当然知道这个词。就爱显摆。

lines.en: : Hey, doesn’t this remind you guys of old times?
lines.zh: : 嘿，这不让你俩想起从前吗？

lines.en: scene kirinfield24
: Coming to school early...setting up for morning practice before the rest of the girls get here.
lines.zh: : 早早来学校……在其他女孩到之前把晨练场地布置好。

lines.en: : The gradual sunrise...that metallic taste of canned coffee and how our shoulders would always get sore from carrying our bags.
lines.zh: : 渐渐升起的太阳……罐装咖啡那股金属味，还有我们的肩膀总会因为背包而酸痛。

lines.en: : Feels like forever since all three of us stood here at once.
lines.zh: : 感觉我们三个上次同时站在这儿，已经是好久以前的事了。

lines.en: : These days, it’s just the Champion of Justice and Soccer...
lines.zh: : 这些日子，只剩正义冠军和足球——

lines.en: : That nickname’s never going to stick, Miku.
lines.zh: : 那个外号永远不会流行的，Miku。

lines.en: : Just give it time, Kirin. It’ll stick.
lines.zh: : 给它点时间吧，Kirin。会流行起来的。

lines.en: : Do you guys want to...
lines.zh: : 你们想不想……

lines.en: : Maybe run a few drills or something?
lines.zh: : 也许跑几组训练什么的？

lines.en: : What, in our school uniforms? Since when do {i}you{/i} do anything that constitutes rule-breaking?
lines.zh: : 什么，穿着校服？{i}你{/i}什么时候做过能算违纪的事了？

lines.en: : Yeah, Karin. Your spotless disciplinary record would go up in flames if somebody caught us.
lines.zh: : 就是啊，Karin。要是被人抓到，你那清白的纪律记录可就要付之一炬了。

lines.en: : We’ve still got almost half an hour until the staff starts showing up.
lines.zh: : 离教职工出现还有将近半小时。

lines.en: : Wait, you’re actually serious?
lines.zh: : 等等，你是认真的？

lines.en: : I feel kinda bad doin’ this without the rest of the team...But I also ain’t about to let an opportunity like this slip through my fingers!
lines.zh: : 没带上其他人，我有点过意不去……不过我也绝不会放过这样的机会！

lines.en: : Kirin, go get the traffic cones! Karin, you handle the balls!
lines.zh: : Kirin，去拿交通锥！Karin，你去管球！

lines.en: : On it!
lines.zh: : 收到！

lines.en: : Heh...
: What? What’s so funny?
lines.zh: : 怎么？什么这么好笑？

lines.en: : Ohhhh, nothing. Nothing at all, dearest...pffft....hahah...hahahah!
lines.zh: : 哦呵呵，没什么。什么都没有，亲爱的……噗……哈哈……哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene black
: Kirin, what on earth are you laughing at?!
lines.zh: : Kirin，你到底在笑什么？！

lines.en: : Hahah! Hahahahahahah!! Hahahahahaha!!!
lines.zh: : 哈哈！哈哈哈哈哈！！哈哈哈哈哈！！！

lines.en: : Ahh, {i}youth.{/i}
: How easy it’ll be to miss these days once they’re gone for good...
lines.zh: : 等这些日子一去不返，想起来会多容易啊……

lines.en: : HahahaHahahahahaHAHAHahAHAHAH!!!!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈HAHAH哈AHAHAH！！！！

lines.en: : I still don’t get what- oh. OH. Kirin! Ew! That’s disgusting! Get your mind out of the gutter!
lines.zh: : 我还是不明白——哦。哦。Kirin！恶心！太恶心了！把你的思想从下水沟里捞出来！

lines.en: : Come on, Karin! We can handle the balls together and let Miku get the cones!
lines.zh: : 来嘛，Karin！我们可以一起“管球”，让 Miku 去拿锥子！

lines.en: : Sure! Right after we go to the restroom so I can wash your mouth out with soap!
lines.zh: : 好啊！等我们先去趟洗手间，我好用肥皂把你的嘴洗洗！

lines.en: Nowadays, when I visit my old bus stop, I do it alone.
lines.zh: 如今，我再去那个旧车站，是独自一人。

lines.en: That girl who lived across the street moved away.
lines.zh: 那个住在街对面的女孩搬走了。

lines.en: She has a family now. Their oldest daughter is seven.
lines.zh: 她现在有家庭了。他们的大女儿七岁。

lines.en: All I have is you.
lines.zh: 我拥有的只有你。
